description:
This workflow is the training and postprocessing stage of the FUMD-AI pipeline for simulated vehicular mobility and cellular network data (SUMO + OMNeT++). 
It consumes the AI-ready labeled dataset produced by the companion [FUMD-AI preprocessing workflow](https://doi.org/10.48546/workflowhub.workflow.2311.1) and trains a 2×BiLSTM encoder with a Bahdanau-attention decoder to forecast a vehicle's serving cellular base station 1–7 seconds into the future. 
The pipeline is implemented as a chain of parameterized, papermill-runnable Jupyter notebooks: 
* Step 1 loads and windows a labeled dataset (with an alternate 
* Step 1b for combining multiple simulation runs into one training set); 
* Step 2 trains the model; 
* Step 3 evaluates it on a held-out validation split and, optionally, on other independent runs to check cross-run generalization; 
* Step 4 aggregates and compares metrics across runs or model variants; and an optional 
* Step 5 plots handover/migration events spatially by type and destination cell, over vehicle positions and (optionally) real base-station coordinates and a street map. 
 
A master notebook chains Steps 1–5 end-to-end and ships with a small bundled example dataset so the full pipeline can be run out of the box with no external data. 
Batch-run scripts (local and Slurm) support running the pipeline across an arbitrary set of simulation datasets at once, including a combined-dataset training track validated against held-out runs.
name: FUMD-AI Training & Postprocessing Workflow
